column1: # Triton IO Board — OTA Partition Table
# Flash size: 4MB (use default_8MB.csv variant below for 8MB boards)
# Uncomment below and comment out the 4MB section if your Triton IO board
# otadata : Tells the bootloader which OTA slot to boot from.
# app0    : OTA slot 0 — first running image after factory flash.
# app1    : OTA slot 1 — target for OTA writes.
#   1. New firmware lands in the inactive slot (app1 if app0 is running).
#   2. esp_ota_set_boot_partition() switches boot target to app1.
#   5. If it crashes 3× before doing so
column2: the bootloader rolls back to app0.
